scope: Uniform bounded-coordinate parallel and singleton-sign cost theorems, with exact finite translated-cover, actual-fan and fixed-direction controls. The fixed-q lower order is proved by an infinite averaging argument, not fitted to the finite counts. No full spatial budget, unrestricted G3 improvement, polynomially separating family or novelty established.

uniform_results.fixed_direction_sharpness: For q=(1,-1,-1), max over N/2<=n<=2N+1 of p_(I_n)(q)=Theta(N*log(N+1)); x^2=0 over Q, also radical two-plane realizations.
uniform_results.remaining: q=(a,b,-c) or (a,-b,c), 1<=a<h, b,c>0; unbounded coordinate degrees.
